description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a mock API client for a web application's frontend. It provides dummy implementations of API methods to retrieve various data such as dashboard stats, recent activities, donations, volunteers, projects, and reports, primarily for testing or development purposes.

classes.name: MockApiClient
classes.description: A mock implementation of an API client that simulates backend data responses for frontend development and testing.

methods.name: simulateLatency
methods.description: Simulates network latency by pausing execution for 250 milliseconds.

methods.name: getOverviewStats
methods.description: Returns mock overview statistics for the dashboard.

methods.name: getRecentActivity
methods.description: Provides a list of recent activity items to mimic a user activity feed.

methods.name: listDonations
methods.description: Returns a list of donations, filtered by user role.

methods.name: listVolunteers
methods.description: Returns a list of volunteer data.

methods.name: listProjects
methods.description: Returns a list of mission projects.

methods.name: listDonorCrm
methods.description: Returns donor CRM activities, filtered by role.

methods.name: listReports
methods.description: Returns report items, filtered by role.
